title: Lineage block (multimodal / derived events)
description: Attached to derived/multimodal PlatformEvents so any artifact traces to its origin and replays deterministically (spike X1 / issue #11). Combined with correlation.correlationId this forms the lineage chain EvidenceUploaded -> EvidenceAnalyzed -> downstream domain events.

parentEventId.description: The event this was derived from.

processedBy.description: agent/tool id (+ model) that produced this artifact.

ontologyRefs.description: Ontology entity ids this artifact maps to (D1).
